summary: The group discussed having Tyler Gray, an actor on the CEO team, author a book as a 'fake SEAL' to promote a potential book and movie, with the book titled 'The West Seal Story' priced at $74,000. Rob O'Neill was recognized as the 'Drinking Bro of the Year' and will have his name engraved on the Brosman trophy; his organization, RobertJoneal.com, is highlighted as a source for speaking engagements, testimonials, and apparel. Dinner is scheduled for the group, with Ross Patterson hosting.
